The current person (the last of the exchange, or the target) with a national side (+0x24) that is a second team (0x5409b0, cdecl): 0x11 its id and flag 1; otherwise −1. The record (0x4486c0: push 1; push offer; mov ecx, `[0xad9dac]` -> thiscall, ret 8) adds flag 2: 0x10 the flag; the next free index receives +0x11. Tells whether the club can take the player on loan: current club, contract record, playing role, whether the club can reach him, the rule of the club's nation and of the current club month by month over the loan period; the reason text in the message. \n Ret 0xc; SEH frame without a destructor (the local date and texts): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::can_loan_player(club, player, message)`, 1 can and 0 cannot. If the club cannot reach the player (0x8ce990: push 0; push &reason; push club; push player; mov ecx, this, ret 0x10): 0 and, with a message, the text for the reason (0x21 the club of the agreed offer, 0x4cca30, or the current one, clearing bit 0x40 of the 8-byte record in `[[0xde1f54]+0x86e]` without an offer; 0x27, 7 and 1 in the message; 0x12/0x13; 0x19, 0x28 and 0x1a with the nation's adjective, 0x6181d0: push 0xd; push 0x64; push text; push nation; add esp, 0x10). The rule of the club's nation (of the 28 at this+0x8ac, the one whose +0xa equals `[club+0x53]`): virtual +0x20 (push 0; push message; push player; push club; mov ecx, rule) equal to 0 gives 0. The rule of the current club's nation: without it, 1. The loan period (0x8d0590: push &end_year; push &end_month; push &start_year; push &start_month; push player; push contract club; push club; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x1c): start equal to end gives 1. Otherwise the date (day of the month, start; 0x54a130: push −1; push year; push month; push day; lea ecx, date -> thiscall, ret 0x10) and virtual +0x24 (push 1; push &date; push 0; push player; push current club; mov ecx, rule) different from 0 gives 1; it advances one month (0x549f70: push −1; push end_year; push end_month; push day; lea ecx, local -> thiscall, ret 0x10) while the end date is after the date, again 0x54a130 and the virtual (different from 0 gives 1); once past: 0, with "This loan deal cannot go ahead" in the message.

Removes the player from the offer's part-exchange list (or from his other offers), his value goes to the price, the news, the computer seller's reply and the offer goes on. \n Ret 0x10; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local list): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::remove_exchange_player(person, offer, only_this, reason)`, from the contract offer to the player (0x8c1e40), the confirmation by the club (0x8c3310), the release of the offer's players (0x8c6ae0) and the screen. Only this one: without the exchange list (+4), nothing; with the person in it (+0 of each item = id), he leaves (0x68d1f0), his 8-byte record (`[this+0x86e]` + id × 8, +2) loses an offer, the news (0x8de150 with the value = +0x52 of the person + +0x1b of the offer and the reason) and, with the owner of the target's contract (0x4cf5a0, except type 5) being the computer (0x600a50), its answer (0x8c8090 with &offer and 1): a resolved offer (status 2, 3, 0x14, 0x10, 4, or 0xf with +0x2e ≥ 3) only frees the empty list; otherwise the price (+0x1b) becomes the value and the offer goes on (0x8c2f50). Otherwise, with the person in some offer (+2 of the record): his offers by the club (0x8c5e40 into a local list), except this one; in each, he leaves the exchange list (the empty list is freed) and, from the first one that had him, the price becomes +0x52 + the price, the news (reason 0) and the offer goes on.

Checks the offer's work permits: of the target at the buyer (refused: the offer collapses, status 0x10, rescheduled in 10 days, returns 0) and of each part-exchange player at the seller (refused: he leaves the exchange and his value goes to the price); the news and the offer goes on. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::check_offer_work_permits(offer, quiet)`, from the processing of the offer (status 0xa, 0x8c6880) and the completion (0x8cbc40). The owner of the target's contract (0x4cf5a0, `[0xae1080]`; any type). Target (+0xc) with a permit to request at the buyer (+8) and a proposal, not granted (check_work_permit): the offer collapses (0x8de790 with 0x13), status 0x10, the proposals closed (0x8c6db0), the bid marks removed (0x84aeb0 on the list manager `[this+0x856]`: the buyer and the target, then the owner of the target's contract and each exchange player), rescheduled in 10 days (0x8c6220) and returns 0. Granted (or no proposal) and without `quiet`: the grant news (0x8e3130). Then, each exchange player (+4) at the owner of the target's contract: refused, the news (0x8e35a0 with value +0x52 + the price), he leaves the exchange (0x68d1f0), his 8-byte record loses an offer and the price (+0x1b) becomes the value; granted without `quiet`, the news. The empty list is freed; without `quiet`, the offer goes on (0x8c2f50). Returns 1.

One slice of the transfer day: window notices, overdue offers rescheduled, the slice's bucket processed; in slice 2 the base date moves to tomorrow, instalments at month end, nation rules; on day 100 the +0x1e of non-EU persons at the club for years. \n Ret 8; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local dates): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::daily_update(today, slice)`. Without a base date (year +0x84f zeroed), it becomes today (0x417c10: push today; push out; lea ecx, `[this+0x84d]` -> thiscall, ret 8) and slice +0x855 today's. Only with today equal to the base and the slice equal to +0x855: in slice 0 the window notices (0x8c6bc0: push today; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 4); on a day that is a multiple of 7, each overdue offer (date +0x12/+0x14 before today; status +0x2c not 0x13, 7, 8 or 0xa) is rescheduled for tomorrow (0x8c6220 with 1 day); slice +0x855 goes up 1; the free transfer queue (0x8c18c0: mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0); the current bucket (0xe-byte lists at this+0x18 + 0xe·(3·`[+0x84c]` + slice), cursor at the start): each valid index of vector `[this]` (count +4) with today's offer and of this slice (+0x1a) is processed (0x8c63a0: push slot; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 4); the bucket is emptied (0x68d080). In slice 2: the base becomes tomorrow (0x54c5b0 push 1; push out; mov ecx, base -> thiscall, ret 8 and 0x417c10), +0x855 goes back to 0, +0x84c goes up (from 49 back to 0); when the month changes from today to tomorrow (0x54cfb0: mov ecx, date -> thiscall, ret 0), the instalments (0x8caee0); on day 0, the old transfers to the archives (0x8c3eb0) and the work permits (0x8c7330); virtual +0 of each of the 28 nation rules (`[this+0x8ac]`, push today; mov ecx, rules); on a day that is a multiple of 7, the permits again. In slice 0 (other than slice 2), the future transfers (0x8cbbe0). On day 100 of slice 2: the day-100 dates of 5, 2 and 10 years ago (0x549ef0: push year; push 0x64; lea ecx, local -> thiscall, ret 8) and, for each person (0x6e-byte records in `[0xae23bc]`, count `[0xae2364]`, reread) with date +0x3e/+0x40 before the 2-year one, a club (`[[+0x39]+0x53]`) in a nation (`[+0x71]`) with id `[0x9cfa10]` and not EU-eligible there (0x53d740: push club; push person; add esp, 8 -> cdecl): +0x1e (the second nationality) = the club's nation (club +0x53), if it is `[0x9cf488]` or `[0x9cf434]`; if the date is before the 5-year one and it is not `[0x9cf360]`, `[0x9cf2fc]` or `[0x9cf448]`; or if the date is before the 10-year one.

Dispatches the offer due today by its status: seller response, acceptance, player contract, permits, completion, removal or a new round of the offer. 
 Ret 4; SEH frame (the local lists, built by 0x68d020 and destroyed by 0x68d040 in the same order): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::process_due_offer(slot)`, the offer that falls due today, by status +0x2c. The seller is the club of the target's contract (+0xc; except type 5), the buyer +8. 
 - 0: without a seller, the bid acceptance (0x8c0080: push 0; push slot -> thiscall, ret 8). Human seller: status 4, 14 days (0x8c6220) and the bids unmarked (clear_offer_bid_markers). Otherwise, without flag +0x1f = 1, the AI's answer (0x8c8090: push 0; push slot, ret 8); with it, the seller's prediction (0x84af00, stdcall(seller, target, 0 i64, buyer, −1 i64, 1): ecx = `[this+0x856]` is not read): refusal, the loan refusal (0x8bfa30: push 0; push 0; push slot -> thiscall, ret 0xc); accepted, the decision (0x4cc930: push offer; mov ecx, `[0xae1050]` -> thiscall, ret 4), status 8 and the acceptance news (0x8d76d0: push offer, ret 4); with the decision, the refusal-to-move news (0x8d8310: push 0; push offer, ret 8), status 0xf, +0x2e = 3, the bids unmarked, 10 days, and if the offer and those of the list at +0 are closed (0x8d0d90, stdcall(offer)), bit 0 of the target's 8-byte record in `[this+0x86e]` is cleared. 
 - 2, 3, 4, 0xf, 0x10, 0x14: with 0xf and +0x2e < 3, +0x2e = 3 and 10 days; otherwise the offer is removed (0x8d0f60: push offer, ret 4). 
 - 1: human buyer: status 4, the bids unmarked and 10 days; otherwise 0x8c0f40 (push slot, ret 4) with +0x1f = 1 or 0x8c0810 (push 0; push slot, ret 8). 
 - 5, 6: human buyer: status 9 and 10 days; otherwise the contract to the target (0x8c1e40: push offer; push target; push buyer, ret 0xc). 
 - 7 with an exchange (+4): human seller: status 8 and 10 days; otherwise, on a copy of the list (0x68d2f0: push list; lea ecx, local, ret 4), the contract to each exchange player until the offer becomes active. 
 - 0xa: the permits (0x8c7690: push 0; push offer, ret 8). 0xe: the completion (0x8c34e0: push 0; push offer, ret 8). 
 - 0x11, 0x12: status 0; with +0x10, the offer passes to the clubs (0x8c2f50: push offer, ret 4); otherwise, with a human manager at the contract club (0x7875e0, stdcall(club): ecx = `[0xb7431c]` is not read), the offer-made news (0x8d3090: push offer, ret 4) and 28 days; otherwise the offer value (0x8e7b50: mov ecx, offer -> thiscall(offer, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1), ret 0x14) and the seller's prediction (seller, target, value, buyer, −1, 0): 0 accepts (0x8c0080), 1 or 2 refuses (0x8bf680: push 0; push 0; push slot, ret 0xc).

Checks an offer's restrictions: completion date, board veto, budget (1.1 times, plus the shortlist offers), squad room and the nation rule; 0 allows, 1 or 2 block. 
 Ret 0x10; SEH frame (the local date and list, the list built by 0x68d020 and destroyed by 0x68d040): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::check_offer_restrictions(offer, decider, reason, no_squad)`; 0 allows, 1 or 2 block. The buyer is +8, the target +0xc and the seller the club of his contract (except type 5). 
 - With +0x30 & 0xf and status not 0x13: the completion date (0x8cee70: push &date; push offer, ret 8) goes into the reason; a reason different from 0 gives 2; today before the date gives 0. 
 - Without `no_squad`, a target with a player sheet (+0x61) and type 11..15 in +0x11 (0x53b620, cdecl of the byte): the decider is the seller with +0x2f = 0 and the seller not obliged to accept (0x8cd240, stdcall(offer, 0, 0)), or the decider is the buyer: the veto (0x8cdb80: push reason; push decider; push target; push seller; push buyer; push offer, ret 0x18) gives 2. 
 - The buyer's budget (0x5a0590: push buyer; mov ecx, `[0xae2a38]`, ret 4; 0x598800: push 0 ×4; push target; mov ecx, finances, ret 0x14, returns i64; negative becomes 0) rounded to the next step (0x43f4e0: push 4; lea ecx, &money, ret 4) and the offer value (0x8e7a70: mov ecx, offer -> thiscall(offer, 0, 1, 1, 0), ret 0x10). The decider is the buyer: value > budget × 1.1: reason 3; a human buyer gives 1; otherwise the budget plus the +0x1b of the buyer's offers (0x8cdd80: push 0; push buyer; push person, ret 0xc) for the players on his scouting list (0x8420e0: push &list; push buyer; mov ecx, `[this+0x856]`, ret 8) exceeding the value gives 1, otherwise 2. Within budget, no room in the squad (0x8cd450: push reason; push no_squad; push offer; push club, ret 0x10) gives 1. 
 - The decider is the seller: no room in his squad gives 1. Reason 0. With an exchange (+4) or type 11..15: the rule of the decider's nation (`[this+0x8ac]`, the one whose +0xa equals `[decider+0x53]`): virtual +0xc (push reason; push 0xae2c90; push decider; push offer; mov ecx, rule) different from 0 gives 0; reason 9 with +0x30 & 0xf = 5 gives 0; otherwise 2. No rule: 0.

Pays former clubs their fee cuts: for a player over 22, (offer fee / 20) / sum of weights × the weight of each of up to five former clubs goes into the buyer's sales; news 0xfc3 goes to the former club when the cut exceeds 11 × reputation − 10000. \n Ret 4; SEH frame without a destructor; this is not used: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::pay_former_club_fee_cuts(offer)`, from a completed transfer with a fee (+0x1b) of a player without +0x69 (0x8c9390). A player (+0xc of the offer) over 22 years old (+0x18): news 0xfc3 (local; 0 = id, 1..3 = the +0x33 of +4/+8/+0xc, 4 = the buyer +8, 7 = the contract club or −1); the sum (16 bits) of the weights (byte +0x12) of the five former-club slots of the 79-byte record (`[0xae2d0c]`, step 5, club at +0xe, −1 = empty slot; a sum of 0 becomes 1). Each slot with a club: ((fee / 20) / sum) × weight (a weight below 1 counts as 1) goes into the sales of the BUYER's finances (0x5a0590 with +8, 0x599800; this is what the original does); above 11 × reputation (+0x80) − 10000 of the slot's club, the news with 5 = the amount and 6 = the club id goes to its manager.

Pays the next-sale percentage: binary-searches the person's clause with the contract club; the cut (percentage × offer fee plus exchange players, or the person's value) from 1000 up: news, transfer totals, paid into the clause club and out of the contract club. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::pay_next_sale_percentage(person, offer)`, from a completed transfer with the person's flag 8 (0x8c91e0). With a contract (and a contract club), looks by binary search (0x946464, 0xd-byte entries in `[this+0x880]`, count `[this+0x888]`, comparison 0x8e54d0) for the clause with +1 = contract club id and +9 = person id. Found: the base is the offer fee (+0x1b) plus the value (+0x52) of each exchange player (+4, LLIST of ids, cursor restarted) when the person is the offer's one (+0xc); otherwise the person's value for the contract club (0x4d0c60 with 0, −1, 0). The cut = percentage (byte +0, signed) × base / 100; from 1000 up: the news (0x8db3a0, with 1 if it was the offer's person), the club's transfer totals (0x448ad0 on `[0xad9dac]`: the cut, the contract club, the clause club +5), the cut goes into the clause club's sales and out through the contract club's purchases. The clause stays (0x8cb4f0 is what removes it).

Sends news 0xfa7: the person, the percentage, the two clause clubs, the cut and the buyer (or the contract club), to the managers of the clause club and the seller. \n Ret 0x10; SEH frame without a destructor; this is not used: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_sale_percentage_news(clause, cut, offer, from_offer)`, from the percentage paid (0x8cb0f0). News 0xfa7 (local): 0..3 the clause's person (+9: id and the +0x33 of +4/+8/+0xc), 4 = the percentage (byte +0), 5 = the clause club (+5), 6 = the selling club (+1), 7 = the cut, 8 = `from_offer`, 9 = the buyer (+8 of the offer) with `from_offer`; otherwise the id of the contract club (0x4cf5a0; without a contract or without a club: ends without delivering). Goes to the managers of the clause club and of the seller (0x7861e0).

Decides the work permit: by the permit record (matches and refusals), a non-player by reputation, the 2001 exceptions, potential above 8500, wage above 34999, youth above 190, under 5 caps no, over 20 with a strong nation yes, and the 16-match national side history (over 11 or 70%), which advances with new matches. \n Ret 0x14: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::is_work_permit_granted(person, nation, offer, record, random)`, from the permit in the scouting list (0x84b180, without offer, record or random), from the accepted contract offer (0x8c38b0, with the offer) and from the offer's permits (0x8c7690). The person's contract (0x4cf5a0, without writing `[0xae1080]`): of type 2 it is the "loan", otherwise the "contract". With the permit record (the given one, or found by binary search 0x946464 in `[this+0x93a]`, count `[this+0x93e]`, 14 bytes, when flag 0x20 exists): without an offer, granted if matches (+4) > 3 × refusals (+6) or refusals < 4; with an offer, the same rule if the loan ends after the offer (+0x2d) or the contract club is not the offer's (+4), and granted if the loan does not end after. Non-player (+0x69 without sheet +0x61): reputation (+0xc) above 160. In 2001, the two cases of Collin and Devon at Falkirk. Potential (+0xd of the sheet) above 8500 (with random: 8000 + random(1000)); offer wage (+0xc) above 34999; under 24 years with ability (+7) above 190: granted. Fewer than 5 caps (+0x22): not granted; more than 20 with the nation's reputation (+0x8e) above 3000 and under 32 years: granted. The history advances with the national side's new matches (`[[0xb74318]+4]` + nation id × 0x6e + 2; each one pushes a zero bit) and the count stays. The window: 16 matches, or those of the two-year period (0x58d710, up to 16) from 2003; with more than 11 matches marked (random: 11 − random(3) + random(3)) or more than 70% (70 − random(10) + random(10)): granted.

Returns the squad status for the refusal reason (0x200: 1, 0x400: 2, 0x2000: 5) or that of the contract with the club (+0x4f >> 4); no contract, 0. \n Ret 8; this is not used: `transfer_manager_get_squad_status_for_reason(person, reason)`, from the offer screen. The person's contract (0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`) gives the club; the contract with it (0x4cf5f0); without it, 0. The reason (signed 16 bits) 0x200 gives 1, 0x400 gives 2, 0x2000 gives 5; the others, the contract status (+0x4f >> 4). Returns in al.

Returns the address of slot i of the negotiation array; out of range, the start of the array. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::get_negotiation_slot(i)`, from the automatic reply to news items (0x782f70) and from the screens: the address of slot `i` of the negotiation vector (`[this+0xc]`, count `[this+0x10]`, signed); outside the count, the start of the vector.

The club rejects the loan offer: state 2, the bids unmarked, the news, the offer comes back in 10 days to be removed, the person's offer mark cleared with no open rival, the contract offers closed and the buyer's shortlist status. \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::reject_loan_offer(slot, mark, reason)`, from the computer seller that refuses every loan bid (0x8c8090, offer with +0x1f = 1) and from the scheduled offer (0x8c63a0). With `mark`, +0x2d = 1; state 2 (refused) straight away; the person's contract goes into `[0xae1080]` and gives the contract club; the buyer's bids for the player and those of the contract club for the exchange players are removed (0x84aeb0); the news (0x8d5170); the offer comes back in 10 days (0x8c6220) to be removed; with no open rival, the person's offer mark is removed (+0x86e); the contract offers (0x4cca70 and, through slot +0x20, 0x4ccb30 for each exchange player, whose mark +4 is zeroed), with +0x10 = 0 between them; finally the status in the buyer's scouting list (0x849ce0; found, 0x843e10 with event 1 and type 0). It is the transfer refusal (0x8bf680) without the unsettling, without the future transfer, without closing the linked contract offers and without the exchange players' part at the end: the `cpx1_*` helpers (with the dry run OFFER_RESPONSE_DRY_RUN) serve the same way.

Checks that the offer keeps the club (with its partner) within 50 players and the coach (5), physio (3), scout (7) and assistant slots; a computer buyer without an exchange releases for free the cheapest player who can leave; otherwise reason 4 or 0x22 (plus 1 for the seller) and 0. \n Ret 0x10; the map gives it as stdcall, but the two call sites in 0x8cfc90 put the manager in ecx and it uses it for 0x8c1780 and 0x8c1af0: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::check_squad_limits(club, offer, count_queue, reason)`, from the offer restrictions (0x8cfc90), for the buyer and for the seller. Null club: the box at line 0x2c3b and 0. The club's partner (0x540a50 with 0 and 1). For the buyer (+8 of the offer = club id): the offer's person already belongs to it (contract of type 5, again through 0x4cf5a0, with the club; or the loan record 0x4cf6d0 with +4 = the club) counts −1; a player by the offer's type +0x11 counts +1; a staff type by the same byte marks 1; each exchange player (+4, LLIST of ids) who leaves is discounted (player −1, staff −1 by the person's +0x3d). For the seller: without an exchange, 1; the player sold counts −1 and the staff type −1 (by +0x3d); each incoming exchange node adds by byte +6. A positive count: adds the 50 of the squad (+0xd7, pointers with a live id) of the club and of the partner; above 50, minus the club's free queue (0x8c1780) if `count_queue`; still above 50: other than a computer buyer without an exchange, the reason (club ≠ buyer) + 4 and 0; otherwise the cheapest of the squad ((+0x3d of the contract + 100) × value +0x52, with +0x3d ≤ 0, without a sheet, without a type 5 contract in `[0xae1080]`, without offers 0x8c5cf0, exchanges 0x8c5e40 or future transfer 0x8cca10, outside the free queue and not of type 0xb, 0xf or 0xd) leaves for free (0x86d800 on `[0xdd7f00]`, 0x8c1af0 with −1); none, the reason + 4 and 0. Then the marked staff slots: 5 coaches (+0x19f), 3 physios (+0x1cf), 7 scouts (+0x1b3), those of the club counted by pointer and those of the partner only with a live id, and the assistant (+0xd3 of the club or of the partner, occupied); over the limit, the reason + 0x22 and 0. Returns 1.

With the person's flag 8, binary-searches the person's next-sale percentage clause with the contract club; when not found, clears the flag. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::find_next_sale_percentage(person)`, from the person screens (0x884ea2): without the person's flag 8 (`[this+0x86e]` + id × 8), 0. Her contract (0x4cf5a0, in `[0xae1080]`) and the club; without both, 0. The binary search (0x946464: cdecl(key, vector `[this+0x880]`, count `[this+0x888]`, 0xd, 0x8e54d0)) by the key with the club id (+1, again through the contract) and the person's (+9), the only two fields the comparison reads; found, returns the record; otherwise flag 8 is cleared and 0.

After the match, on both sides: pays the appearance money at 1, 10, 20... 50 games (club by contract, national side by caps since the deal) and removes the paid bonus; in a counting match, adds an appearance to the work permit of those who played and an absence to those left out without injury, ban, call-up or loan. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::update_appearance_clauses_after_match(match, fixture)`, from the end of each match (0x6b5f00 and the simulated statistics 0x84be20). For both sides (+0x1c home, +0x20 away): the match counts for work permits with a competition (+0x14) that is not a national side's (home side through 0x53b900) nor a friendly (0x5c6710) and the side's byte (+0x40/+0x41) set, or with +0 = −2. A club that is not a national side: the squad (0x541f90, 50 slots; national side: the vector stays as it was) and, when counting, its players with flag 0x20 (the 8-byte record at +0x86e). In the 20 match slots (+0x190 the id, +0x1ad ≠ −5, substitutes with +0x1c2 ≠ −1; without a player sheet +0x61, end of the slots): outside a loan (0x4cf6d0, only at the club) and with the clause flag (2 club, 4 national side), the matches (national side: +0x22 minus byte +7 of the record; club: +0x3b of the contract 0x4cf5a0) that are multiples of 10 up to 50, or 1, pay the bonus (0x8cb340 with type 5 or 2) and, once paid, the bonus is removed (0x8cb630 or 0x8cb590). When counting, the marked player adds a match (+4 of the permit) and leaves the list; those remaining, without injury (0x62c400), suspension (0x55d270), call-up (0x7757d0) or ineligibility (0x8cf5e0), and not loaned by another club (0x4cf6d0 with the contract stored in `[0xae1080]`), add an absence (+6).

Appends the international appearance money (13 bytes) to the array, growing by 50, and sorts it by person. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_international_team_appearance_money(record)`: appends the national side appearance bonus (13 bytes copied from `record`) to vector `[this+0x898]` (capacity +0x89c, count +0x8a0); full, grows by 50 at a time (out of memory: box 0x25af and nothing). Sorts by person (qsort 0x945333 with 0x8b4e00). The twin for the senior team is 0x8cac40.

Sends the 0xfa5 news of the agreed transfer, with the completion date, to the human seller and buyer. \n Ret 4; SEH frame for the local date and news item: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_transfer_finalised_news(offer)`, from the agreed transfer (0x8c2f50). The seller: the club of the person's contract (0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`) except type 5 (requested again, without storing). News 0xfa5: the person (the id and the three keys), the buyer, the seller (or −1), +0x20, +0x24, the fee +0x1b, the state +0x2c, the total (0x8e7a70 with 0, 1, 0, 1), +0x2f, +0x11; the completion date (0x8cee70) after today goes in fields 0xe (day), 0xf (year) and 0xd (the low nibble of +0x30, signed), otherwise 0, 0, 0; the exchange count (+4) in 0xb. To the human seller (0x7875e0), outside state 0xc and without a pending exchange (+0x2f with nibble +0x30), and to the human buyer, each in field 0x10.

Records the free transfer and, unless record only, pays the club's compensation, removes the person from shortlists, selections, squad, offers and contract, clauses and work permit. \n Ret 0x14: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::free_transfer_staff(person, club, reason, compensation, record_only)`, from the free transfer queue (0x8c18c0), from the end of contracts (0x4c7ac0) and from 0x8cd450. A person on loan (0x4cf6d0): nothing. The past transfer (0x25 bytes in vector `[this+0x862]`, capacity +0x866, count +0x86a; full, grows by 100 at a time; out of memory: box 0xce9 and nothing): +0x10 −1, +0x14 the club or −1, today's date in +0x1d, the person (the id and the three keys), +0x1c 5 (record only) or 3, +0x18 0. Record only: done. Otherwise: with a player sheet (+0x61), the history (0x7c5fe0 on `[0xb74350]` with the reason); with a club, the compensation (−1: with a type 2 contract, the days until the end (0x85fa00) × the wage (+0xc) / 7; otherwise 0) paid to the club (0x599920), the status in the scouting lists (0x843e10, event 4, type 2) and, at the current club (+0x39), the two line-ups (0x896c60 on `[0xde1d08]`) and the squad (0x53c190), with date +0x3e set to today; the contract offers of the contract club (0x4cca70, contract stored in `[0xae1080]`), the main contract (0x4d0b50), +0x52 and +0x6d zeroed, the three clauses (0x8cb4f0, 0x8cb590, 0x8cb630), the work permit (0x8c7e20 without a club) and 0x4196a0 on `[0xad9c6c]`.

Sends the 0xfac news of permission to discuss a contract to the human buyer and, per exchange player, to the human seller. \n Ret 4; SEH frame for the local news items: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_contract_talks_news(offer)`, from the accepted offer (0x8c0080). The seller: the club of the person's contract (0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`) except type 5. Human buyer (0x7875e0): news 0xfac with the person (the id and the three keys), the seller (or −1), the buyer, +0x20, +0x24, 0 and 0. Human seller with an exchange (+4): one 0xfac per exchange player, with him, the buyer, the seller, +0x20, +0x24, 0 and 1, to the seller.

Rejects the offer: the player may become unsettled, state 2, bids unmarked, contract offers closed, the news, back in 25 days for removal and the person's offer flag. \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::reject_transfer_offer(slot, mark, reason)`, from the selling club that refuses (0x8c36b0 and the bid evaluation). With `mark`, +0x2d of the offer = 1; the player may become unsettled (0x8c1290); a future transfer (state 0x13): leaves the list (0x8cbf70). State 2 (refused); the buyer's bids for the player and those of the contract club for the exchange players are removed (0x84aeb0); the linked contract offers are closed (0x8c6db0); the news (0x8d5170); the offer comes back in 25 days (0x8c6220) to be removed. With no open rival, the person's offer mark is removed (+0x86e). The buyer's scouting list (0x849ce0, 0x843e10), the contract offers (0x4cca70, 0x4ccb30) and +0x10 = 0; with an exchange and a computer seller, the exchange players in the buyer's list (0x842080, 0x843e10).

Withdraws the offer: state 3, held contract offers resubmitted, bids unmarked, back in 10 days; for reason 2, the unsettling; the news and the contract offers. \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::withdraw_transfer_offer(slot, mark, reason)`, from the buyer who gives up (the bid review and the collapsed offers). With `mark`, +0x2d = 1; a future transfer: leaves the list (0x8cbf70); state 0xb and above: the held contract offers come back (0x4cf4a0). State 3 (withdrawn); the linked contract offers are closed (0x8c6db0); the bids are removed (0x84aeb0); +0x10 = 4; the offer comes back in 10 days (0x8c6220). With no open rival, the person's offer mark is removed. Reason 2: the player may become unsettled (0x8c1290). The buyer's scouting list, the news (0x8d5170), the contract offers and +0x10 = 0; with an exchange and a computer seller, the exchange players in the buyer's list.

Sends the 0xfa1 news of a rejected or withdrawn offer, with the reason, to the interested human clubs. \n Ret 8; SEH frame for the local news item: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_offer_rejected_news(offer, reason)`, from the refusal, the withdrawal and the loan refusal. The human clubs that receive it (0x8d1130, with 0x2d if the offer is refused, otherwise 0x2e; up to 30); with none, nothing. News 0xfa1: the person (the id and the three keys), the contract club (without a type 5 contract; none for reason 6 with +0x2f), the buyer, the exchange list (+4), the state, the reason, +0x1f, the total value (0x8e7a70 with 0, 0, 0, 1) and the contract club's division (+0x57); to each recipient, in slot 12, 1 if it is the buyer or the contract club.

A random draw against the buyer's reputation flags the player as unsettled; when flagged, a score from his attributes and interest leads to the 0x80 complaint, going missing and grudges. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::unsettle_player_after_bid(offer)`, from the refusal (0x8bf680), the withdrawal with reason 2 (0x8bfcb0) and the club that refuses (0x8c36b0). Random(5750) + 4250 below the buyer's reputation (+0x80): +0x2d of the offer = 1. With +0x2d = 1, a contract club, a buyer and a player sheet: the interest x (0x846920 by status 0x849f00) and the score n = (8 × ambition² − 1600) − reputation / 40 − min(x⁴, 300 × x) − 2 × loyalty²... (attributes +0x5d, +0x57, +0x5b, +0x59 through the game's pow); transfer-listed (+0x4e & 8): − 2000 − random(6000). With x of 5.5, n < −random(700), (n < −4000 or +0x5b + +0x59 < 15), reputation above 3500 and the offer's weighted value (0x8e7b50) above the lesser of 1.5 × value (0x4d0c60) and 0.8 × price (0x4d1600): the 0x80 complaint (0x867700); a player of 5250, aged 19 to 31, n < −8000, with the criterion (0x866f60), without flag +1 of record +0x86e and present (0x418f60): goes missing (0x419840) and, with +0x44 − random(200) + random(400) < −150, rejects the club (0x547e70). x above 10, n < −5000 or the lesser below 0.75 × the weighted value: dislike of the manager (0x547af0).

Sends the 0xfb0 news of a collapsed offer, with the club and the reason, to the interested human clubs. \n Ret 0xc; SEH frame for the local news item: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_offer_collapsed_news(offer, club, reason)`, from the accepted contract offer (0x8c38b0), the collapsed offer (0x8c44e0), the work permits (0x8c7690) and 0x8c4950. The human clubs that receive it (0x8d1130 with 0x2f, up to 30); with none, nothing. News 0xfb0: the contract club (without a type 5 contract), the buyer, the person (the id and the three keys), the club, the reason and +0x1f; to each recipient, except the club itself for reason 0xb.

Sends the 0xfa6 news of appearance money paid, to the paying club and to the contract club. \n Ret 0x10; SEH frame for the local news item: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_appearance_money_news(clause, amount, type, silent)`, from the appearance bonus (0x8cb340). Silent, without a contract or without its club: nothing. Otherwise news 0xfa6: the clause's person (+0: the id and the three keys), +4, the amount, the paying club (+9), the type and the contract club; to the paying club and to the contract club.

Carries out the transfer: board confidence, nation rules, clauses, payment, records, former clubs' cut, the player and the exchange players moved, squad numbers, state 0x14 and back in 10 days. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::finalise_transfer(offer)`, from the closing of the offer (0x8c34e0) and from the future transfer. The boards' confidence (0x6978f0); the rules of the buyer's nation (the 28 at +0x8ac, by nation +0xa): method 1 (without +0x1f) or 2 with the offer; the previous clauses (0x8c91e0); with a seller (contract not of type 5), the payment (0x8ca8a0); without +0x1f = 1, the manager's records (0x86cd70); the club records (0x448760). With an exchange, the first exchange player leaves his club's squad (+0xd7, 50 slots). With a fee (+0x1b) and without +0x69 on the person, the former clubs' cut (0x8e4f20). The player goes to the buyer (0x8c9720) and the exchange players to the seller, with the squad numbers; state 0x14, the offer comes back in 10 days (0x8c6220); with no open rival, the offer mark (+0x86e) is removed; the bids (0x84aeb0) and the linked contract offers (0x8c6db0).

Sends the 0xfa8 news of a completed transfer, with the fee, the exchange players, a random draw and the player's strong points. \n Ret 4; SEH frame for the local news item: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_transfer_completed_news(offer)`, from the closing of the offer (0x8c34e0). The human clubs that receive it (0x8d1130 with 0x5f, up to 30); with none, nothing. News 0xfa8: the person, the buyer, the contract club, the fee (+0x1b), 0, the total value (0x8e7a70 with 1, 1, 0, 1), +0x2f, +0x11, the clauses (0x8e7ef0); with +0x2f, a club contract and +0x30 & 0xf = 3, the end of the contract if it is still to come (slots 10 and 11). The exchange players (up to 3, from slot 15) and how many (14); a random(3) in the next slot; with a player sheet, 1, the strong points (0x546ab0, random) and the positions (0x5b7d20), otherwise 0.

Sends the 0xfb3 news of the clubs' agreement, with the fee, the exchange players and the completion date. \n Ret 8; SEH frame for the local news item: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_transfer_agreed_news(offer, date)`, from the clubs' approval (0x8c3310). The human clubs that receive it (0x8d1130 with 0xf, up to 30); with none, nothing. News 0xfb3: the person, the buyer, the contract club, the fee (+0x1b), +0x2f, the total value (0x8e7a70 with 0, 1, 0, 1), the low nibble of +0x30, signed, the completion date (signed day, year), the exchange players (up to 3, from slot 13) and how many (12).

Adds a loan from the configuration file: the checks, the contract extended to its end, the loan contract, the squad, the squad numbers and the work permit. \n Ret 0x10; SEH frame for the local contract: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_config_loan(person, club, start, end)`, from the configuration file loans at the start of the game. Through the conditions (config_loan_allowed), the loan goes to the linked B team or to the club: with the end after the person's date +0x46, the date and the contract end (+0x2d) move to the end; the local contract (0x85e410, 0x85e590 with the end, 0, 1, 1; start in +0x25) is signed (0x4d01e0); the suspensions are kept (0x5563f0); squad 1 (0x540980); +0x6d 2 becomes 0x10; the squad numbers (0x85add0, 0x85a470); in the B team, the person goes to the reserves (0x4cc0f0). Needing a work permit at the club (0x8c7560), the received end moves 7 days and the permit is given (0x8c7070 with the club's nation and the start year).

Sends the 0xfab news of a club asking to delay a transfer by a week, to the interested human clubs. \n Ret 8; SEH frame for the local news item: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_transfer_delay_request_news(offer, reason)`, from the club that asks to delay the transfer by a week. The human clubs that receive it (0x8d1130 with 1, or 2 outside state 0x11; up to 30); with none, nothing. News 0xfab: the contract club (not type 5) or −1, the buyer, the person (the id and the three keys), the state, 0, 0, slot +0x20 and the reason; to each recipient.

Records one club's approval (states 0xb to 0xe); once both agree, schedules completion for today or, with the deadline still ahead, books a future transfer. \n Ret 8; SEH frame for the local list: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::confirm_offer_by_club(offer, club)`, from the offer passed to the clubs (0x8c2f50), the news and the screen: the club's approval changes the state (`state_after_approval`); with both in agreement (0xe): without a deadline (+0x30 & 0xf), the offer is scheduled for today (0x8c6220 with 0, 1); with a deadline, a completion date (0x8cee70) still to come makes it a future transfer: a local LLIST it does not use (0x68d020/0x68d040), the player (+0xc) and the exchange players (list +4) leave the other offers (0x8c41c0, and 0x8c47d0 for the exchange players), the offers held for the player are removed (0x4cf560), the news (0x8e05d0) and the future transfer (0x8cb9a0) with the date; a date already reached: scheduled for today.

Tries to complete an offer: rechecks buyer and seller; a refusal collapses or rejects the offer; with both agreeing, completes the transfer or defers it to the end of the contract. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::try_complete_offer(offer, at_deadline)`, from the scheduled offer (0x8c63a0) and from the end of the window (0x8c4e10). The seller is the club of the player's contract (+0xc; 0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`; type 5 does not count); the buyer (+8) reconfirms (0x8cfc90, which gives the reason): outside the deadline with reason 9, it does not count; a computer buyer with answer 1: the refusal (0x8c36b0); answer 1 or 2: the offer collapses (0x8c44e0 with the reason, 1). The same with the seller. Both in agreement: the player and the exchange players leave the other offers (0x8c6ae0), the offers held for the player are removed (0x4cf560), the news (0x8dbef0); with confirmation (+0x2f), a seller and the contract-end deadline (+0x30 & 0xf = 3), the future transfer at the end of the contract (0x8cb9a0 with +0x2d of the contract); otherwise the transfer is completed (0x8c9390).

Pays and clears the old clauses (next-sale percentage, club and international appearance money) of the player and the exchange players. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::settle_previous_transfer_clauses(offer)`, from the completed transfer (0x8c9390): the old clauses of the player (+0xc) and of the exchange persons (list +4, cursor restarted; the original removes the next-sale percentage of the offer's player, not that of the exchange person).

Advances the offer to club approval: once every player agrees, cancels the rival offers (rescheduled in 20 days), waits for the work permit (18 to 24 days) or passes the offer to the buyer's and the seller's decision. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::advance_offer_to_club_approval(offer)`: buyer = club +8; seller = the club of the player's contract (+0xc), none for a type 5 contract (0x4cf5a0 twice, `[0xae1080]`). Outside status 0xa (+0x2c): only with +0x10 = 2 and all the exchange players (+4) with +4 = 2. The other offers for the same player (list +0, indices into vector `[this]`; except +0x20) fall: status 0xf, +0x2e = 3, rescheduled in 0x14 days (0x8c6220), and the bid marks (0x84aeb0 on the list manager `[this+0x856]`) of the buyer and of the owner of each exchange player are removed. Without flag +0x30 & 0xf, with a work permit to request (0x8c7470) and +0x2e = 0: the waiting news (0x8e2a00), status 0xa and rescheduled in 18 + random(7) days. Otherwise status 0xb, the transfer news (0x8da5e0) if one of the clubs is human, and the decision of the computer buyer (0x600a50): with a restriction (0x8cfc90) it refuses (0x8c36b0, +0x2e < 3) or withdraws (0x8bfcb0, which can change the offer); otherwise confirms (0x8c3310). Then the seller: with +0x2f or without a seller it confirms directly; a computer seller refuses with a restriction or confirms.

Sends the 0xfa3 news of an accepted offer to the human clubs involved. \n Ret 4; SEH frame without a destructor: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_offer_accepted_news(offer)`: the player's owner (+0xc; contract 0x4cf5a0, none for type 5), the recipients (0x8d1130 with 0x2d, up to 30), news 0xfa3 (local): 0..3 the player, 4 = the owner's id (or −1), 5 = +8 (buyer), 6 = +4, 7 = +0x20, 8 = +0x24, 9 = +0x1f; delivered to each recipient (0x7861e0).

Sends the 0xfb5 news of a loan offer to the human clubs involved; without a contract, the error box. \n Ret 8; SEH frame without a destructor: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_loan_offer_news(offer, terms)`: the recipients (0x8d1130 with 0x2e, up to 30); with none, nothing. News 0xfb5 (local): 0..3 the player (+0xc), 4 = +8, 5 = the id of the contract club (none for type 5: the original reads address 0), 6 = +0x20, 7 = +0x24, 8 = terms +0xc, 9 = +0x2c, 10 = terms +0x2d (signed word), 11 = terms +0x2f (word); without a contract, the "Error" box (0x5e4c) and nothing; otherwise 12 = contract +0xc and the delivery to each one.

Stores the offer terms in a new negotiation (the array grows by 50; the next id) and schedules the offer in 2 days, or in 14 with news for a human buyer. \n Ret 0xc; SEH frame only for the `new`s: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_transfer_negotiation(offer, terms, mark)`: with `mark`, +0x2d = 1 in both and the player marked under offer (0x84b580, with list +0). Without a slot (+0x28 = −1): the negotiation vector (+0xc, capacity +0x10, count +0x14) grows by 50 when full (0x945667 zeroing the new ones; 0x945501 without a vector), the first empty slot goes to +0x28 and the offer to status 1 (with no empty slot: the "Error" box 0x60f and nothing). The slot's old negotiation is destroyed (0x8e5710, 0x944c94), or the count goes up; a new one (0x41 bytes, 0x944cf1 and 0x8e5680) receives the terms field by field (the date +0x12 through 0x417c10; of +0x30 and +0x31 only the low 4 bits), +0x20 of the offer and the next id (+0x85a); list +4 of the terms is copied into a new one (0xe bytes, 0x68d020, 0x68d2f0). A human buyer (terms +8): the negotiation news (0x8e4610 for a loan +0x1f = 1, otherwise 0x8d6bf0) and the offer scheduled in 14 days; otherwise in 2 (0x8c6220).

Sends the 0xfae news of the player refusing the move, with the reason and both clubs' managers. \n Ret 8; SEH frame without a destructor: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_player_rejects_move_news(offer, reason)`: the player's owner (+0xc; contract 0x4cf5a0, none for type 5), the recipients (0x8d1130 with 0x2f, up to 30), news 0xfae (local): 0..3 the player, 4 = the owner's id (or −1), 5 = +8, 6 = +0x1f, 7 = the reason, 8 = the owner's manager, 9 = the buyer's manager (+8 > −1); to each recipient.

Initialises the work permits: marks 0x3fff/0x1fff by international caps; for a player needing a permit (0x8c7560), by the earliest year in the club's nation (career 0x7c3e40): under 5 years, the permit (0x8c7070); otherwise the second nationality (+0x1e); sorts the permits. \n Ret 0; SEH frame only for the local date: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::init_work_permits()`, from creating the game (0x8bba30). For each person: with more than 13 caps for the national side (+0x22), 0x3fff in word +3 of the 8-byte record (`[this+0x86e]` + i × 8); with more than 5, 0x1fff. A player (+0x3d = 0xb) at a club (+0x39) that needs a work permit (0x8c7560 without ignoring the given one): the earliest year in the club's nation from the career (0x7c3e40, a group of 6 entries of 0x2b bytes per season; stops at the first club of another nation), starting from the year of +0x40. Fewer than 5 years up to today's year (`[0xae2c92]`): the permit (0x8c7070, without sorting; before that the original moves date +0x3e forward 52 weeks at a time up to date `[0xdd6ec8]`, without using the result); otherwise the second nationality (+0x1e) becomes the club's nation. At the end sorts the permits (qsort 0x945333 with 0x8e55c0).

Returns the clause count: type 4, international caps since the deal (+0x22 minus byte +7 of the person record); otherwise club appearances (+0x3b of the contract). \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::get_clause_count(person, type)`: in type 4, the caps for the national side (+0x22) minus those at the time of the deal (byte +7 of the 8-byte record `[this+0x86e]` + id × 8); otherwise the club appearances (+0x3b) of the contract (0x4cf5a0, requested twice as in the original), or 0 without a contract.

With the person's bit 2, searches the appearance money array +0x88c; when not found, clears the bit. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::find_first_team_appearance_money(person)`: with bit 2 of the 8-byte record (`[this+0x86e]` + id × 8), searches for the person's appearance bonus in vector `[this+0x88c]` (count +0x894; binary search 0x946464 with 0x8b4e00, 13-byte records) and returns it; not found, clears the bit (adds 0xfe to the byte) and returns 0.

Processes the free transfer queue: for each queued player (+0x92c), at a human club the board may block it (0x696940); a random draw adds the manager to the disliked staff (0x547af0); the records (0x86d800), the cancelled offers (0x8df9b0) and the release with the compensation (0x8c1af0); clears the queue. \n Ret 0; SEH frame for the two local LLISTs 0x68d020/0x68d040: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::process_free_transfer_queue()`, from the daily transfer update (0x8c5880). Goes through a copy of the queue header (+0x92c, 14 bytes, with the cursor at the start); for each item (+0 person id, +4 reason, +5 compensation) with a contract (0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`) and a club: at a human club (0x7875e0) without a reason, the board may block it (0x696940; blocking, 0x6a0990 and the next one); otherwise the club joins the rejected clubs (0x547e70) and the manager (+0xcf) the disliked staff (0x547af0), and the board records it (0x697430). Without a reason, a random draw by +0x5b against another of 20 (or liking the club, 0x547d60) puts the manager in the disliked staff. Then the release records (0x86d800), the cancelled offers (0x8df9b0) and the release (0x8c1af0 with reason and compensation). At the end the copy becomes the empty list, the queue is cleared (0x68d080) and the two locals are destroyed.

Finds the first day, from today up to a year later, with the club's nation window open (0x8e8e50; without a rule, today); when none, the "Error" box. \n Ret 8; SEH frame only for the local dates: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::find_next_window_open_date(club, out)`: the rule of the club's nation (+0x53) among the 28 at +0x8ac (+0xa); from today (`[0xae2c90]`) up to a year later (0x54c5b0 with 365), the first day with the window open (0x8e8e50; without a rule, today) goes into `out`; not found, the "Error" box 0x32c6. The desired signing (0x85fc50) overwrites the date with today right afterwards.

Returns the +0x946 list item with the person and the club, or 0. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::find_negotiated_loan_contract(person, club)`: in list `[this+0x946]` (cursor +0xa goes back to the start), the item with the person (+0) and the club (+4) by their ids; without a list or not found, 0.

Builds the clause offer option: with a much bigger bidding club and a high-potential player up to 30, a new offer (0x8e5680, 0x8e78f0) with a 20% sell-on (appeal 80), international (70) or first-team (60) appearance money, and the fee × 0.8; none, frees the offer and 0. \n Thiscall with `this` unused, ret 0x14; SEH frame for the `new`: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::build_clause_offer_option(club, player, out, appeal, value)`, from the computer club's answer to a bid (0x8c8090). With the bidding club more than 3 above the current club (0x4cf5a0) in reputation (+0x80), a player sheet (+0x61) with potential (+7) at least 25 above ability (+5) and up to 30 years old (+0x18): a new offer (0x944cf1 of 0x41 bytes, 0x8e5680) in `*out`, initialised with the value (0x8e78f0), and appeal 50. Bidding club below 15 with the sheet's reputation (+0xb / 500) more than 2 above: 20% of the next sale (+0x3f), the value × 0.8 and appeal 80. Otherwise, a player without caps (+0x22) from a nation (+0x1a) above 5000 (+0x8e): the national side appearance bonus (+0x3a, value × 0.3, per 10 matches +0x3e), the value × 0.8 and appeal 70. Otherwise, a sheet reputation more than 3 below the club's: the team appearance bonus (+0x35, value × 0.3, per 20 matches +0x39), the value × 0.8 and appeal 60. None: the offer is destroyed (0x8e5710, 0x944c94; `*out` keeps the pointer, as in the original) and 0.

Returns 0 when the rejection reason does not fit: hot prospect (0x2000) aged 24 or more, same division (0x1000), rival (0x800) without a fixture or link; otherwise 1. \n Stdcall, ret 8: `transfer_manager_is_rejection_reason_valid(reason, offer)`: 0 when the reason does not fit the offer (person +0xc, bidding club +8): 0x2000 (prospect) with 24 years or more (+0x18); 0x1000 with the current club (0x4cf5a0) and the bidding club in different divisions (+0x57); 0x800 (rival) with both clubs, not both human (0x600a50), without a league fixture (0x4b02e0) and neither being a partner (+0xb3/+0xb7/+0xbb) of the other. Otherwise 1.

Returns the rejection reason by the squad status of the current club contract: 1 → 0x200, 2 and 3 → 0x400, 5 → 0x2000; otherwise 0. \n Stdcall, ret 4: `transfer_manager_get_squad_status_reason(offer)`: the refusal reason from the squad status (+0x4f >> 4) of the contract of the person (+0xc) with the current club (0x4cf5f0): 1 → 0x200, 2 and 3 → 0x400, 5 → 0x2000; otherwise 0.

Fills the 42-byte squad restrictions table with 0xff and, by the fixture's rules scope (0x8d2fa0), lets the nation or continent rule fill it (virtual +0x1c); when asked, keeps only the first limit (+5/+3, +2/+0 or +0x16/+0x17). \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::fill_squad_restrictions(fixture, t, main_only)`: fills the 42 bytes of `t` with 0xff. With a fixture: the rules' scope (0x8d2fa0); 0xff stops there. Outside type 4, the first of the 28 rules at +0x8ac of the continent (+0xe, type 2) or of the nation (+0xa) with the same type (+0x12) fills the table (virtual +0x1c with the fixture and `t`). With `main_only`, only the first limit that exists remains: +5 or +3 (written into +5), +2 or +0 (written into +2), or +0x16 with +0x17; the rest goes back to 0xff.

Counts, over the matchday squad slots (given players or the tactics 0x8968f0), the non-EU, foreign or over-age players of the fixture limit (0x8cf7e0); when over, 1 and the message. \n Thiscall through `this` in ecx, which the original passes straight to 0x8cf7e0; ret 0x18: `transfer_manager_check_matchday_squad_limit(club, fixture, msg, players, _, out)`: the fixture's limit (0x8cf7e0 into 6 local bytes: +0 type, +1 age, +5 count); without a type, 0. The human side (+0x1c/+0x40 or +0x20/+0x41) goes to 0x8968f0. Over the (+0x4d & 0xf) + 11 slots, the slot's person (`players[k]` or the tactic `[0xde1d08]` 0x8968f0) counts if foreign in the club's nation (0x53d980 with 1; type 1, also outside the EU, 0x53d740) or over the age (+0x18, type 3): +2 (starters) or +3 (the others) and +4 (all). The count goes into `out`; exceeding the limit, 1 and, with `msg`, the warning (0x66f4e0) by the type, the count and the limit.

Returns 1 when the club's nation uses work permits (+0x76 = 0xe), the player is not EU and holds no granted permit (type 2 contract, 0x20 flag, search in the +0x93a array). \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::player_needs_work_permit(player, club, ignore_given)`: 0 without a club or without its nation (+0x53); null player: the "Error" box 0x1c23 and 0. Nation without flag 0xe (+0x76) or an EU player (0x53d740 with nation 0): 0. With `ignore_given`: 1. Otherwise 0 only if the contract (0x4cf5a0) is of type 2 (+0x35 & 0x3f), the id fits in `[0xae2364]`, it has flag 0x20 (`[this+0x86e]` + id × 8) and the permit is in vector `[this+0x93a]` (count +0x93e; binary search 0x946464 with 0x8e55c0); otherwise 1.

Tells whether the club can bid for the player. Cannot (0 and the reason): nation that keeps its players (0x27), agreed contract (0x21), open exchanges (7), free queue (1), offer in negotiation (0x12, flag +0x2d) or future transfer (0x20), the rules of the Basque club (0x19), of nation `[0x9cf4dc]` (0x28) and of clubs `[0x9d0128]`/`[0x9d01a0]` (0x1a); otherwise 1. \n Ret 0x10; SEH frame for the local LLIST 0x68d020/0x68d040: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::can_club_bid_for_player(player, club, reason, ignore_open)`: cannot (0 and the reason) if the player is from nation `[0x9cf458]` without a club or with a club of that nation and the club is from outside (0x27); with the agreed contract flag (0x40) and the agreement (0x4cca30) (0x21; without an agreement, the flag is removed); without `ignore_open`, with exchanges offering him (0x8c5e40) or exchange negotiations (0x8c5fc0) (7); in the free transfer queue (+0x92c) (1); under offer (0x8cde70), through the offers for him (0x8c5cf0): one in negotiation (states 0xa to 0xe; flag +0x2d) (0x12) or a future transfer (0x13) (0x20). By the club: Basque (0x53d7f0) with a player foreign in nation `[0x9cf424]` (0x19); of nation `[0x9cf4dc]` outside `[0x9cf8d8]` (+0x57) with a foreign player (0x28); clubs `[0x9d0128]`/`[0x9d01a0]` with a player without nation `[0x9cf424]` (0x1a). Otherwise it can (1, reason 0).

Flags that the exchange player was sent terms; when none is flagged, the offer moves to state 8 (from 7) or 6. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::note_terms_offered_to_exchange_player(k, person)`: `k` negative or beyond the count (+4): the "Error" box (0xdc3 or 0xdc8). In offer `k` (empty: nothing), through the list of exchange players (+4), marks (+4 of the item) that of `person`; no item marked: the state (+0x2c) becomes 8 (if it was 7) or 6.

Counts the free transfer queue persons of the club or of its partner club (0x540a50). \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::count_club_free_transfer_queue(club)`: null club: the "Error" box 0xc04 and 0. Otherwise counts the persons of the free transfer queue (+0x92c; the cursor goes back to the start) with the contract club (+0x39) equal to the club or to its partner (0x540a50 with 0 and 1), non-null.

With the 0x10 flag, searches the offers for the player (0x8c5cf0) and the exchanges offering him (0x8c5e40) for a state 0x13 one; found, the +0x920 array entry and 1; otherwise clears the flag and 0. \n Ret 8; SEH frame for the local LLIST 0x68d020/0x68d040: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::get_future_transfer(player, out)`: without flag 0x10 (`[this+0x86e]` + id × 8), 0. Through the offers for the player (0x8c5cf0) and, not found, through the exchanges offering him (0x8c5e40, with the list emptied by 0x68d080), the first in state 0x13 with an index ≠ −1; with `out`, the 12-byte record of vector `[this+0x920]` (count +0x928) with the offer at +8; 1. None: clears flag 0x10 and 0.

Clears the 0x10 flag of the player and the exchange players and removes the offer's entry from the +0x920 array (the next ones move down, 0x8cbf40). \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::remove_future_transfer(offer)`: clears flag 0x10 of the player (+0xc) and of the exchange players (list +4, the cursor goes back to the start); in vector `[this+0x920]` (count +0x928), the first record with the offer (+0x20 of the offer, +8 of the record) is removed: the following ones move down one (0x8cbf40) and the count drops by 1.

Adds (date, offer) to the +0x920 array and sorts it; the offer moves to state 0x13; suspends the shortlists for the player and the exchange players (0x842b00) and sets their 0x10 flag; a flagged contract keeps the offer. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_future_transfer(offer, date)`: appends to vector `[this+0x920]` (capacity +0x924, count +0x928; full, grows by 10 at a time, out of memory: box 0x27c3 and nothing) the 12-byte record with `date` (0x417c10) and the offer (+0x20 at +8) and sorts it (qsort 0x945333 with 0x778e90). The offer gets +0x2d = 1 and state 0x13. Suspends the clubs targeting the player (0x842b00 of `[this+0x856]`, with 0) and sets his flag 0x10; with a contract (0x4cf5a0) flagged at +0x49, the offer goes to +0x4a of the contract. The same (suspend and flag) for each exchange player (list +4).

Counts (and lists the indices of) the open offers for players contracted to the club, except states 2, 3, 4, 0x10, 0x14, collapsed ones and loans. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::get_open_offers_for_club_players(club, list)`: over the offers (vector `[this]`, count +4), excluding the empty ones, those in state 2, 3, 4, 0x10 and 0x14 and those in state 0xf with +0x2e ≥ 3: is the contract of the player (+0xc; 0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`), when it is not a loan (+0x35 & 0x3f ≠ 5), with `club`? Counts and, with `list`, appends the index (4 bytes, 0x68d0d0). Returns the count.

Collapses the offers for a player: each offer for the player loses its future transfer (0x8cbf70), is collapsed (0xf, +0x2e = 3), clears the buyer's and seller's bid markers (0x84aeb0) and is scheduled (0x8c6220, 10 days). \n Ret 4; SEH frame for the local LLIST 0x68d020/0x68d040: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::collapse_offers_for_player(person)`: with offers for the person (byte +1 of the 8-byte record in `[this+0x86e]`), through the offers for her (0x8c5cf0 into the local list): one that is a future transfer (0x13) loses the future transfer (0x8cbf70); all go to state 0xf with +0x2e = 3; the seller is the club of the offer player's contract (0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`); the buyer's (+8) bids for the player and the seller's for the exchange players (list +4) are removed (0x84aeb0 of `[this+0x856]`) and the offer is scheduled (0x8c6220 with 10 days).

Appends the 13-byte next-sale percentage to the +0x880 array (growing by 50) and sorts it (0x8e54d0). \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_next_sale_percentage(record)`: appends the next-sale percentage (13 bytes copied from `record`) to vector `[this+0x880]` (capacity +0x884, count +0x888); full, grows by 50 at a time (out of memory: box 0x2553 and nothing). Sorts it (qsort 0x945333 with 0x8e54d0, the order of search 0x8cb0f0).

Returns the offer's completion date by its timing type (+0x30): today, the first allowed day (0x8cf0e0), the seller's season end plus 7 days, the day after the contract ends (never before today) or the start of the fixed window; returns the reason. \n Ret 8: `transfer_manager_get_offer_completion_date(offer, out)`: the date on which the offer can go through, by the deadline type (+0x30 & 0xf): 0 today; 5 the start of the fixed window (0x8d0bb0); 1 and 4 the first day the rules allow (0x8cf0e0, which gives the reason); 2 the season end of the selling club's nation plus 7 days (0x669bd0; outside the season, today; without a seller, the "Error" box 0x31da); 3 the day after the contract end (+0x2d), never before today (without a contract, today). Other types write nothing. Returns the reason (only ax: 0 outside types 1 and 4). The seller (0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`) is always computed.

Steps day by day, from today (or the contract end, in type 4) up to a year, until the rules of the buyer's and seller's nations allow it (method +0xc); with no day, returns the first reason. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::find_next_allowed_transfer_date(offer, out)`: writes today into the output and starts at the later of today and, for deadline type 4 (+0x30 & 0xf), the contract end (+0x2d). Type 5: the start of the fixed window (0x8d0bb0) and method +0xc of the rule of the buyer's (+8) nation gives the reason (9 does not count). A person without a player sheet (+0x61): today. Otherwise steps day by day (up to today + 365, not reaching it) through the rules of the buyer's nation and, with +4 of the offer and a seller (0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`), of the seller's: the first day both allow (or whose reason releases: 0x14, 0x15, 0x1f, 0x11) goes into the output and returns 0; with no day, returns the first reason (9 does not count) and the output stays today. Only ax is returned.

Returns the start (today, when inside) and the end of the current or next window: 1 to 31 July and 15 December to 15 January. \n Stdcall, ret 8: `transfer_manager_get_next_window_dates(start, end)`: the fixed windows of today's year are 1 to 31 July and 15 December to 15 January (0x549f70; compared only by the day of the year, signed). Inside a window, the start is today and the end that of the window (15 January of the following year, if it is the December one); before July, 1 to 31 July; between August and 14 December, 15 December to 15 January of the following year. The end only with a non-null `end`. Does not use ecx (the callers pass the manager).

Calculates the compensation fee: staff on a type 2 contract, what is left of the contract (1000 to 1000000); new rules: the average with the player's value; between clubs of nation `[0x9cf4a8]` or, under 24, between British nations: half the value (0x4d0c60). \n Stdcall, ret 0xc; SEH frame only for the local date: `transfer_manager_calc_compensation_fee(person, buyer, no_new_rules)`: without person or buyer, the "Error" box 0x372e and 0. Staff (without a player sheet +0x61, with +0x69) on a type 2 contract: what is left of the contract (days until the end +0x2d × the wage +0xc / 7) between 1000 and 1000000. New rules (`[0xae233c]` = 1, without the argument) with a type 2 contract: the average of what is left and the player's value at the seller (0x4d0c60). Otherwise (a contract not of type 5, both nations): between clubs of nation `[0x9cf4a8]`, half the value; outside that, only under 24 years at the date (the contract end, for type 2; otherwise today) and between British nations or Ireland (0x5446d0), half the value. The other cases, 0.

Adds the fee to the totals, the buyer pays and the seller receives the first instalment, stores the remaining instalments (list +0x872) and the sell-on and appearance clauses, with the person's flags. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::pay_fee_and_record_clauses(offer)`: adds the fee (+0x1b) to the transfer totals (0x448ad0); the buyer (+8) pays and the seller (club of the contract of person +0xc, 0x4cf5a0) receives the first instalment (the fee / instalments +0x40, or all of it), in 64 bits (0x599890, 0x599800). With instalments, stores the remaining ones (13 bytes: the instalment, the ids of buyer and seller, instalments − 1) in list +0x872 (0x68d0d0) and adds to +0x1c of the finances the instalment × −5/21 (buyer) and × 5/21 (seller). Stores the clauses: the next-sale percentage (+0x3f, 0x8caaf0, flag 8), the team appearance bonus (+0x35 with byte +0x39, 0x8cac40, flag 2) and the national side appearance bonus (+0x3a with +0x3e, 0x8cad90, flag 4); the flags go in the person's 8-byte record in `[this+0x86e]`.

Returns 1 when the fee covers an active release clause (reason 0x1b) or the seller in financial trouble gets far more than the value (reason 0x1c); without a seller, 1. \n Stdcall, ret 0xc; SEH frame only for the local values: `transfer_manager_selling_club_must_accept(offer, strict, reason)`: without a seller (the club of the contract of person +0xc that is not of type 5, 0x4cf5a0), 1. With an active release clause (0x867b50), without an exchange (+4) or instalments (+0x40) and the fee (+0x1b) not below the clause amount (+0x21 of the contract; both through 0x43f460 with 4): reason 0x1b and 1. With the seller in crisis (+0x165 of the finances = 1), the asking price (0x4d1600) not below 20 × the reputation (+0x80; at least 20000), the offer's weighted value (0x8e7b50) above 50000 and double it above the price: reason 0x1c and 1 (with `strict`, only if the price is below 1.3 × the weighted value). Otherwise 0.

Updates the work permit on a move: when the new club needs a permit, updates the existing one (nation, year) or grants a new one (0x8c7070); otherwise removes any permit and re-sorts the array. \n Ret 8; SEH frame only for the local date: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::update_work_permit_on_move(person, club)`: if the player needs a permit at the new club (0x8c7560 with 1) and already has one: replaces the permit's nation (+0xa) with the club's (+0x53), zeroes +4 and +6 and, if the nation changed and neither has flag 0xe (+0x76), writes today's year (+8); a club without a nation: the "Error" box 0x1dc2. Without a permit: the new one (0x8c7070 with today's year, sorting), after today + 52 weeks (0x54c770, unused). If he does not need one (0x8c7560 is called again) or without a club: removes whatever permit he has (flag 0x20, the last one in its place, count − 1 and re-sorts with 0x945333).

Completes an accepted contract offer: without the work permit, the news of the collapsed offer or the refused permit and 0; otherwise signs (0x4cf720), the club pays the signing-on fee and 1. \n Ret 4; SEH frame for the local offer: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::complete_accepted_contract_offer(offer)`: contract offer (+0 the person, +4 the club, +8 the signing-on fee, +0x61 the role). If the player needs a permit at the club (0x8c7560 with 1) and it is not granted (0x8c7950): with a type 5 contract (0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`), the news of the collapsed offer (0x8de790 with a local TRANSFER_OFFER: 0x8e5680, ids at +8 and +0xc, +0x1f = 0, reason 0x13; 0x8e5710); otherwise the refused permit news (0x8e4290); returns 0. Otherwise signs (0x4cf720) and, once signed, the club pays the signing-on fee (0x5a0590, 0x5998e0) and returns 1.

Builds the club's contract (0x4cda70, factor 1) and adds the contract offer; without one, withdraws the offer (main player) or drops the player from the exchange adding his value. \n Ret 0xc; SEH frame for the local contract: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::offer_contract_to_offer_player(club, person, offer)`: builds the contract (local STAFF_CONTRACT, 0x85e410) the club would offer (0x4cda70 with the offer's slot +0x20, wage factor 1 and mode 2). Built: adds the contract offer (0x4cc490 with slot +0x20, the value +0x24, 0xb, 0, 1, 0). Without a contract: if he is the main player (+0xc), updates the club's list (0x849ce0 and 0x843e10 with 1) and withdraws the offer (0x8bfcb0, reason 0x16); if he is from the exchange, adds his value (+0x52) to the offer's (+0x1b) and takes him out of the exchange (0x8c41c0 with 1 and 0x16). Returns what the last call returned.

Collapses the offer: state 0x10, closes the proposals, releases the bids, posts the news, schedules the removal, clears the flags, the contract offer and the exchange contracts. \n Ret 0x10: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::collapse_offer(offer, club, reason, remove_future)`: in an offer in state 0x13 clears flag 0x10 of the person (+0xc) and of the exchange players (list +4) and, with `remove_future`, removes the future transfer (0x8cbf70). Sets state 0x10, closes the proposals (0x8c6db0), releases the buyer's (+8) bids for the person and the seller's (contract club, stored in `[0xae1080]`) for the exchange players (0x84aeb0), posts the news (0x8de790 with the club and the reason) and schedules the offer (0x8c6220 with 0x14). With the offer and all those of list +0 closed (states of `is_offer_state_closed`), clears flag 1 of the person. Updates the buyer's list (0x849ce0 and 0x843e10 with 1), removes the contract offer (0x4cca70), zeroes +0x10 and releases the exchange contracts (0x4ccb30 with slot +0x20; +4 of the item = 0).

Processes the future transfers whose date has come: collapses those the restrictions block, completes the others (0x8c9390) and removes them from the array. \n No arguments: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::process_due_future_transfers()`: goes through the future transfers (12 bytes: +0 the date, +8 the offer index; `[this+0x920]`, count +0x928) up to the first after today (0x456740). Null offer: the "Error" box 0x2846. With the permits (0x8c7690 with 1): if the restrictions (0x8cfc90) block it for the buyer or, if there is a seller, for the seller (reason 9 does not count), collapses the offer (0x8c44e0 with the club and the reason); otherwise the news (0x8dbef0), completes it (0x8c9390), state 0x14 and schedules (0x8c6220 with 0xa). Then removes the processed ones from the start of the vector (0x8cbf40 one by one) and decreases the count.

A club rejects the offer: counts the offer's attempt; by the refusing side, a random(2 × attempts) rejects or withdraws the offer, otherwise it is rescheduled with the delay news. \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::club_rejects_offer(offer, club, reason)`: outside states 0x11/0x12 (+0x2c), counts the attempt (+0x2e). Refusal by the selling club (id = +8): state 0x12; reason 8 (16 bits) reschedules (0x8c6220 with 7, 0) and exits; otherwise, with no human club in the player's contract (+0xc; contract in `[0xae1080]`, +0x35 & 0x3f ≠ 5, 0x600a50) and more than one attempt, a random(2 × attempts) different from 0 rejects the offer (0x8bf680 with the offer's address, 0, 6) and exits. Refusal by the other side: state 0x11, unsettles the player (0x8c1290); with a computer selling club and the random draw, withdraws the offer (0x8bfcb0); with reason 8 the rest reschedules and exits (without the attempts test). At the end: reschedules and gives the delay news (0x8dda90 with the whole reason, as the original pushes it).

Takes the offer's player and each exchange player out of other offers and collapses the offers for each exchange player. \n Ret 4; SEH frame for the local list: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::detach_offer_players(offer)`: builds a local LLIST it does not use (0x68d020, destroyed at the end by 0x68d040), takes the offer's player (+0xc; 0x8c41c0 with the offer, 0, 0) out of the other offers and, through the exchange player list (+4, reread on each call, cursor restarted), takes out each one (0x8c41c0) and collapses the offers for him (0x8c47d0). The exchange player's id is reread from the item after 0x8c41c0, as in the original.

Allocates and initialises a cash offer for the player at the given fee (0x8e78f0), stores it in the output, appeal 50, and returns 1. \n Ret 0x14; SEH frame only for the new offer: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::build_cash_offer_option(club, player, out, attraction, value)`: allocates the offer (0x944cf1(0x41) and 0x8e5680), stores it in `out`, initialises it with the player, the buying club and the value (0x8e78f0, which may draw random numbers) and sets the attraction to 50. A club without finances (0x5a0590 = 0): the original routine ("Error" box).

Returns the offer response delay: from the time until the window closes (the rules of the buyer's and the player club's nations), 0 days, 1 or 2 days with random slices, or a value from the player's interest (0x846920) or randomly drawn from the status; days = value / 3, slices = value % 3. \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::get_offer_response_delay(offer, days, slices)`: the deadline is the window closing (0x8e8ed0) of the buyer's (+8) nation (without a rule: 365) and, with +4 of the offer, the lesser of that and the one of the nation of the club of the player's (+0xc) contract (a type 5 contract does not count). Below 3: 0 days and 1 slice; below 6 or 11: 1 or 2 days and 1..3 random slices. Otherwise the value by the status of the contract with the club (+0x3d; without it −100): a player (0x53b620 of +0x11; without a sheet, the "Error" box) with ability +7 of the sheet above 130 and above the club's reputation / 60, under 26 years old, in fewer than 3 lists and with a positive status, with the interest (0x846920) above `[0x968e58]`: the deadline × `[0x968e18]` up to `[0x968dd8]`; otherwise a random draw up to status/10 + 12 (the larger with 1..3). Days = value / 3, slices = value % 3.

Pays each transfer instalment (payer's and receiver's finances), adds the fractions to the instalment figure (+0x1c) in the last 8, removes the finished ones and zeroes the figure of clubs without an instalment in its direction. \n Ret 0: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::pay_transfer_instalments()`: at the end of the month, each instalment in the list (+0x872; 13 bytes: +0 the amount, +4 the paying club, +8 the receiving one, +0xc the number remaining) is paid (0x599890 on the payer's finances, 0x599800 on the receiver's, 0x5a0590) and counts one fewer; with fewer than 4 or 8 remaining, the instalment figure (+0x1c of the finances) receives the fractions (`[0x968918]`/`[0x968f30]` or `[0x967880]`/`[0x969518]`); finished, it leaves the list (0x68d1f0); otherwise both clubs are marked (0x945501). Then, in each club with finances, the figure is zeroed: without a mark; positive only when paying; negative only when receiving.

Removes the offer: destroys the linked offer, removes the pair from the loan list and the contract offers of the exchange and of the player, lowers the player's (+0x86e) and the manager's offer counts, the lowest free slot follows and the offer is destroyed. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::remove_offer(offer)`: the linked offer (+0x28 ≠ −1, in +0xc) is destroyed (0x8e5710, 0x944c94), the slot is zeroed and count +0x14 drops; with +0x1f at 1, the pair (club +8, player +0xc) leaves the loan list (+0x946); for each exchange player (+4): the contract proposal linked to slot +0x20 is removed (0x4ccb30, if the offer's player has a contract) and +2 of his 8-byte record (+0x86e) drops; the player's contract proposal with the buyer is removed (0x4cca70), +1 of the player's record drops, the lowest free slot (+0x85e) follows, slot +0x20 of the vector (+0) is zeroed, the offer is destroyed and count +8 drops.

Returns 1 when the person flagged as under offer (bit 0 of `[+0x86e]` + id × 8) has, among the open offers (0x8c5cf0), one from the club (offer +8); else 0. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::club_has_offer_for_player(person, club)`: 1 if the person flagged as under offer (bit 0 of `[this+0x86e]` + id × 8) has, among the open offers (0x8c5cf0 without `all`), one from the club (+8 of the offer = club id); otherwise 0 (also for an id outside the table).

Returns the club's offer for the person (with `all`, closed ones too and without requiring the flag), or 0. \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::find_club_offer_for_player(person, club, all)`: the club's offer for the person (the first in the list from 0x8c5cf0, with `all` also the closed ones), or 0. Without `all`, the person must be flagged as under offer; id outside the table: 0.

Returns 1 when the person is under offer (0x8cde70) and an open offer is in state (+0x2c) 0, 1, 5 or 6; else 0. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::player_has_pending_offer(person)`: 1 if the person is under offer (0x8cde70 without the human view) and one of the open offers (0x8c5cf0) is in state (+0x2c) 0, 1, 5 or 6; otherwise 0. An index beyond the count (+4) reads offer 0, as the original.

Tells whether the player is under offer: without the human view, the "under offer" flag (bit 0 of `[+0x86e]` + id × 8); with it, 1 when an offer is known (+0x2d), comes from a club of the current human or is for a player of his club, when the person is on his shortlist or when he has an accepted contract offer for the person. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::is_player_under_offer(person, view)`: id outside the table: 0. Without `view` (or without a human whose turn it is), the "under offer" flag (bit 0 of `[this+0x86e]` + id × 8). With it: 1 if some open offer for the person (0x8c5cf0, into a local list) is known (+0x2d), is from a club of the human whose turn it is (0x600c90) or the current club of the offer's player (+0xc; contract 0x4cf5a0, which stays in `[0xae1080]`) is his, or if the person is on his shortlist (0x7f7490; valid after the 1st offer); finally, 1 if the human (+0x39) has an accepted contract offer (0x4cc9e0, +0x35 & 0x3f = 5) for the person. Otherwise 0.

Returns 1 when the nation of the club of the person's contract has free transfers at contract expiry (0x544670); without a contract, club or nation: 1. \n Stdcall, ret 4: `player_club_uses_bosman(person)`: 1 if the club of the person's contract (0x4cf5a0, stored in `[0xae1080]`) is from a nation with free transfer at the end of the contract (0x544670); without a valid contract, without a club or without a nation (+0x53): 1. Null person: the original routine (box 0x3798 and 0). The original's local date (0x54a110) only serves the SEH frame. Hot (~31 million calls): no counter.

Checks the board veto: with an empty exchange part, the deciding club's board answers (0x696b10, by the 0x8e7b50 value); 0x2000: reason 0x24 and the player loses 10% of his reputations (+0xb current, +9 home, +0xd world); 0x800: 0x17; 0x200: 0x18; each returns 1. \n Ret 0x18: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::check_board_veto(offer, buyer, seller, player, decider, reason)`: the offer value (0x8e7b50 with 0, 0, 1, 0, 1); if the offer's exchange part (+4) is empty (null or word 0), the board of the deciding club answers (0x696b10 on `[0xb67a44]` with the player, the club, the value and "is the buyer" in the low byte of the buyer pointer, as the original pushes it). Bit 0x2000: reason 0x24 and the player (+0x61) loses 10% of reputations +0xb (current), +9 (in the nation) and +0xd (world); 0x800: reason 0x17; 0x200: 0x18; each returns 1. Otherwise 0.

Appends the past transfer (0x25 bytes, 0x8cb940) to the +0x862 vector (capacity +0x866, count +0x86a), growing by 100; returns the new record. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_past_transfer(record)`: appends the past transfer (0x25 bytes, copy 0x8cb940) to vector `[this+0x862]` (capacity +0x866, count +0x86a, which goes up before the copy); full, grows by 100 at a time (out of memory: box 0x2794 and nothing). Returns the new record.

Appends the work permit (14 bytes: person, year +8, nation +0xa) to the +0x93a vector (growing by 30), sets the person's 0x20 flag at +0x86e and, when asked, sorts (0x8e55c0). \n Ret 0x14: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_work_permit(person, nation, year, _, sort)`: appends the work permit (14 bytes: +0 person id, +4 and +6 zeroed, +8 year, +0xa nation id) to vector `[this+0x93a]` (capacity +0x942, count +0x93e); full, grows by 30 at a time (out of memory: box 0x1b1b and nothing). Sets the permit flag (bit 0x20 of `[this+0x86e]` + id × 8) and, with `sort`, sorts (qsort 0x945333 with 0x8e55c0, the order of search 0x8c7560).

Appends the first-team appearance money (13 bytes) to the +0x88c vector (growing by 50) and sorts by person (0x8b4e00). \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_first_team_appearance_money(record)`: appends the first-team appearance bonus (13 bytes copied from `record`) to vector `[this+0x88c]` (capacity +0x890, count +0x894); full, grows by 50 at a time (out of memory: box 0x2581 and nothing). Sorts by person (qsort 0x945333 with 0x8b4e00).

Returns the fixture's rules scope: reserves, the home nation and type 1; friendly, 0xff; otherwise the key nation of the competition (0x669470), the continent (+0x59) and type 4 (0, 1), 2 (3 to 7) or 1. \n Ret 0x10: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::get_fixture_rules_scope(fixture, type, nation, continent)`: the fixture's competition (+0x14) is the reserves one (`[0x9cf684]`): the home side's nation (+0x1c, +0x53), its continent (+0x71, or 0) and type 1. Friendly (0x5c6710 over `[0xae2c74]`): 0, 0 and 0xff. Otherwise, by the competition's key nation (0x669470, signed): the nation from table 0xb63d60 (72 bytes each), the competition's continent (+0x59) and type 4 (keys 0 and 1), 2 (3 to 7) or 1.

Returns the ineligibility code: 9 for an AWOL player (outside national sides); otherwise the first of the 28 rules (+0x8ac) of the continent or nation with the same type answers (virtual +0x18); none: 0. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::get_ineligibility_code(player, fixture)`: a home side (+0x1c) that is not a national side (0x53b900) and a player absent without leave (AWOL: 0x418f60 over `[0xad9c6c]`, with 0, which clears the flag of those without a club): 9.
