Otherwise, by the rules' scope (0x8d2fa0; 0xff and 4: 0): the first of the 28 rules at +0x8ac of the continent (+0xe, type 2) or of the nation (+0xa) with the same type (+0x12) answers (virtual +0x18 with player and fixture). None: 0.

Writes the transfer deadline news text through the rules of the nation in news slot 0 (method +0x30). \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::write_deadline_news_text(news, full, text)`: the text of the transfer deadline news item is left to the rules of the nation in slot 0 of the news item (0x785830): their method +0x30, with the same arguments. Returns what it returns.

Tells whether a loan can end: with the player's parent club in the same nation as the club, that nation's rules answer (method +0x24); else 1. \n Ret 0x14: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::can_end_loan(club, player, a, b, c)`: with the club that owns the player (+0x39) in the same nation (+0x53) as `club`, the rules of that nation answer (the first of the 28 at +0x8ac with an equal +0xa): their method +0x24 with `club`, `player`, `a`, `b`, `c`. Otherwise 1.

Returns 1 when the offer's player needs a permit at the offer club (0x8c7560) or one of the exchange players does at his contract club; else 0. \n Ret 4: `transfer_manager_offer_needs_work_permit(offer)`: 1 if the offer's player (+0xc) needs a permit at the offer's club (+8), or if any of the exchange players (the list at +4, from the start: cursor +0xa goes back to +2 and advances through 0x68d1b0) needs one at the club of his contract (0x4cf5a0 on `[0xae1050]`, written into `[0xae1080]`; without a contract, null club); otherwise 0.

Updates the work permits: clears the flag of whoever lacks bit 0x20; after more than 4 years grants the second nationality and drops the permit; drops the permit of non-players; sorts and trims the dropped ones from the end. \n `TRANSFER_MANAGER::update_work_permits`: in the permit vector (`[this+0x93a]`, `[this+0x93e]` records of 14 bytes: +0 person, +8 year, +0xa nation), the person's flag (byte at `[this+0x86e]` + 8 × id) without bit 0x20 is zeroed entirely; with more than 4 years (game year − +8) the person gains the second nationality (+0x1e = nation +0xa, 0x122 bytes in `[0xae23a8]`), loses bit 0x20 and the permit is dropped (person −1); whoever is not a player (+0x61) also loses it. If any are dropped: sorts (qsort 0x945333 with 0x8e55c0) and discounts those at the end with person −1.

Tells whether the club may sign the player under the nation rules, with the refusal reason and the human club's second try on the foreign player limit. \n Ret 0x18: whether `club` can sign `player`, by the rules of the club's nation (method +0x10 with club, player, a4, a2 and the reason); without rules, 1. The reason (word) goes into `out` (zeroed first). Refused with `a5`, a human club (0x600a50) and a foreign-player reason (0x11, 0x14, 0x15, 0x1f): asks again with the player's nation (+0x1a) replaced by the club's (and restored afterwards); accepted that way, 1.

Returns how many of the club's open offers include the player in the exchange, listing their indices when asked. \n Ret 8: how many open offers of the club of `player`'s contract (0x4cf5a0) offer him in the exchange (list +4 of the offer, a node with his id), noting the index (+0x20) in `out` (0x68d0d0) if there is one. Offers in state (+0x2c) 2, 3, 4, 0x10, 0x14 or 0xf with +0x2e ≥ 3 do not count. Stops on reaching the number of exchanges recorded (`[+0x86e]` + 8 × id + 2); recorded 0 or an id out of range, 0.

Closes (state 4) the contract offers linked to the transfer offer: the target player's and the exchange players'. \n Stdcall, ret 4: closes (state +0x50 = 4) the contract proposals linked to the offer: that of the target player (0x4cc9e0 with id +0xc and club +8) and that of each exchange player (list +4, with the club of the target's contract, 0x4cf5a0).

Counts the open negotiations of the player's club that include him in a part exchange and, if asked, lists the offer indices. \n Ret 8: counts the negotiations (`[+0xc]`, `[+0x10]` of them) of the club of the player's contract (+8) whose offer (`[manager]` + 4 × `[+0x20]`) is still open (states 2, 3, 4, 0x10 and 0x14 not; 0xf only with +0x2e < 3) and that have the player in the exchange list (+4); with `out`, puts the offer index in it (0x68d0d0, 4 bytes). A player outside the database or without a contract: 0.

Counts the transfer offers for a player (skipping closed ones unless asked) and may list their indices. \n Ret 0xc: counts the offers for the person and, with `list`, appends to it (0x68d0d0, 4 bytes) the index of each one. Id from 0xae2364 up or no offer: 0. The offer found without its own list (+0) counts 1 (appends +0x20); with a list, goes through its indices (cursor +0xa restarted from +2) and counts those pointing to offers for the same person. Without `all`, the closed ones are left out (0x8d0d90, inlined here as in the original).

Returns the club of the person's agreed contract (clears the flag when the contract is gone). \n Ret 8: with the agreed contract flag (0x40) of person `*id`, looks for the contract (0x4cca30 on `[0xae1050]`): found, writes into `club` (if not null) the contract's club (`[0xae23b4]`, 581 bytes per club, by the id at +4) and returns 1; not found, clears the flag and returns 0.

Returns the selection limit from the match restriction table (0x8cf6b0), the first one present: type at +0, count at +5 (and the age at +1 for type 3). \n Ret 8: `get_selection_limit(fixture, out)`: zeroes the 6 bytes of the output, asks for the fixture's 42-byte restrictions table (0x8cf6b0 with 1; `this` is passed straight through) and keeps the first one that exists (≠ 0xff): +5 or +3 (type 1), +2 or +0 (type 2), +0x16 with the count in +0x17 (type 3, the age in +1). The type goes in +0 and the count in +5.

Finds the person's work permit: with the 0x20 flag of the id in `[+0x86e]`, the binary search for the permit (0xe-byte entries in `[+0x93a]`); else 0. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::find_work_permit(person)`: the person's work permit: id outside the `[0xae2364]` (signed), 0; without flag 0x20 in the id's byte (8 bytes each, in `[+0x86e]`), 0; otherwise the binary search (bsearch 0x946464, 0xe-byte records in `[+0x93a]`, `[+0x93e]` of them, comparison 0x8e55c0) by the id. Null person: reads address 0 as the original.

Fills a vacated staff job: the first unemployed person of the club's nation in the wanted job (6, 8, 9, 10; 13 → 6, 15 → 8) joins the club (0x53bd10). \n Stdcall, ret 8: `fill_vacated_staff_job(club, job)`: the staff vacancy that became free is filled by the first unemployed person of the club's nation in the job sought (6, 8, 9 and 10; 13 looks for 6, 15 looks for 8): 0x53bd10 with the job (the argument's dword), today's date `[0xae2c90]`, write and without reducing. Null club: the original routine ("Error" box).

The player refuses the terms: the offer returns in 10 days, the bid markers go, his reputation rises if the buyer is more famous; or he leaves the exchange and his value moves to the fee. \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::handle_player_rejected_terms(person, index, silent)`: index outside vector `[this]` (count +4): the "Error" box (0xf49, 0xf4e). Empty slot: nothing. If the person is the offer's player (+0xc): terms refused (+0x10 = 4), status 0xf; +0x2e goes up with a human buyer (0x600a50 without holidays) and +0x1f ≠ 1, otherwise 3; the bid marks (0x84aeb0) of the buyer and of the owner of each exchange player are removed; the list manager notes the refusal (0x843e10) if the buyer is the computer; rescheduled in 10 days (0x8c6220); resolved with all rivals resolved, bit 0 of the player's 8-byte record (`[this+0x86e]`) is cleared; the contract proposals (0x4cca70) of the exchange players with the seller are removed. Without `silent`: with a buyer more famous than the seller (+0x80), the player's reputation (+0xb of sheet +0x61) rises by the difference × 0.075 (above 7750 with the sheet below 4750), × 0.05 (above 4250) or × 0.025, up to 10000; the reply news (0x8d8e90). Otherwise, the person is an exchange player (+4; empty list: box 0x101f): leaves the list (0x68d1f0; the empty list is freed), her value (0x4d0c60) moves to the price (+0x1b), her 8-byte record loses an offer (+2), the news (without `silent`), and the reaction of the computer seller (0x8c8090) and of the buyer (0x8c0810), stopping if the offer became resolved. At the end, the offer goes on (0x8c2f50).

Holds offers at window close: completes the approved offers and puts the nation's offers on hold: news if a human is involved, otherwise withdrawn or rejected; for the computer, status 3 and back the next day. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::hold_offers_at_window_close(nation)`: the nation's rules (of the 28 in `[this+0x8ac]`, the one whose +0xa equals nation +0x53 of the national side 0x53b3d0; otherwise none). For each offer in vector `[this]` (count +4): status 0xe completes (0x8c34e0 at the deadline). Buyer from the nation: not resolved, a player with a sheet (+0x61), without flag +0x30 & 0xf, outside status 0x13 and accepted by the rules (virtual +0xc with the buyer and today; answer 0 = hold): on hold; the waiting news (0x8e1150) if the buyer or the seller is human, otherwise withdrawn (0x8bfcb0); computer buyer (0x600a50): status 3 and rescheduled in 1 day. Otherwise, with players in the exchange and a seller from the nation, by the same tests with the seller in the rules: on hold; the news, or refused (0x8bf680); and the same rescheduling.

Schedules the offer: gives it today's date + days and the day slice (0 to 2, every 3 slices one more day) and puts it in the bucket (days since the base date + start, modulo 50, × 3 + slice) of the +0x18 lists. \n Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::schedule_offer(offer, days, slices)`: without a base date (year +0x84f zeroed), it becomes today (0x417c10 of `[0xae2c90]` into +0x84d) and slice +0x855 today's (`[0xae2c88]`); `days` ≥ 50: the "Error" box (line 0x18b9) and 10 days. The offer gets the date (+0x12) and the slice (+0x1a) of the plan (`vacancy_schedule_plan`) and its +0x20 (4 bytes) goes into the bucket (0x68d0d0, which allocates); returns what 0x68d0d0 returns. No SEH, no random draw.

Returns, of the offers for the player from the club (or flagged) in state 2, the highest (0x8e7a70); 0 when none. \n Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::find_highest_offer_for_player(player, club)`: with the player's offers flag (byte +1 of the 8 of `[+0x86e]`), the first record of vector `[this]` (`[+4]` of them) for the player (+0xc): without a list (+0), itself if it qualifies; with a list, of the offers (indices into the vector) that qualify, the one with the highest value (0x8e7a70 with 0, 0, 0, 1; the first on a tie). Otherwise 0.

With the person's flag 4, binary-searches the international appearance fee clause; when not found, clears the flag. \n Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::find_international_appearance_money(person)`, from the person screens (0x884ea2): without the person's flag 4 (`[this+0x86e]` + id × 8), 0. The binary search (0x946464: cdecl(key, vector `[this+0x898]`, count `[this+0x8a0]`, 0xd, 0x8b4e00)) by the key with the person's id at +0, the only field the comparison reads; found, the record; otherwise flag 4 is cleared and 0.

Pays appearance money: finds the appearance money record (club or national side) and, when the appearances match, posts the news, adds to the totals and the former club receives the amount the current one pays; returns 1 when paid. \n Ret 0x10: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::pay_appearance_money(player, matches, type, arg)`: with a contract (stored in `[0xae1080]`) and the person's bonus record (the whole `type` is passed, as the original pushes it) whose matches (+8, signed) are `matches` (> 0): gives the news (0x8db8a0), adds the amount (+4) to the transfer totals (0x448ad0 on `[0xad9dac]`, with the current and the former club), the former club (+9) receives (0x599800) and the current one pays (0x599890), in signed 64 bits. Returns 1 if it paid.

Updates the transfer window news: checks each transfer window in the previous, current and next months: on the day, the opening or closing notice; the day after the opening, the notice and the nation's waiting offers; a week before the opening, the notice. \n Ret 4; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local dates): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::update_transfer_window_news(today)`, from the transfers' day. The previous, current and next months (0x54cfb0: mov ecx, today -> thiscall, ret 0; the month before January is December of year −1, the one after December is January of year +1), today + 1 week (0x54c770: push 1; push out; mov ecx, today -> thiscall, ret 8) and yesterday (0x54c8e0: likewise). For each window of vector `[this+0x8a4]` (count +0x8a8, reread): in the first of the three months equal to its own (+4), its date in that year (0x40a7d0: push year; push out; mov ecx, window -> thiscall, ret 8; copied through 0x417c10). Today: virtual +0x2c of the rules of its nation (`[this+0x8ac + 4·(+0)]`: push the dword of the date's year; push code 1, or 3 if the window closes (+5), with the high bytes of the same dword; push window -> thiscall, ret 0xc); yesterday and a window that opens: the virtual with 0 and the waiting offers of the rules' nation (+0xa; 0x8c4e10: push nation; mov ecx, esi -> thiscall, ret 4); a week from now and a window that opens: the virtual with 2.

Marks that the transfer offer had contract terms offered to the player. \n Ret 4: marks that offer `k` (not a loan, +0x1f ≠ 1) had the terms offered to the player: state +0x2c becomes 8 if it was 6, otherwise 7. Index outside the list (`[+4]` offers): the original routine (error box).
